claim_boundaries: Coverage remains CPU geometry/font preparation with custom GPU integer compositing; this is not GPU outline rasterization.
Exactly one acquired texture contributes 4,505,600 active bytes, compared with the original Canvas painter before the compositor. The normal run contributes zero comparison bytes.
The fixed HTML/PNG are served on an owned gated loopback origin. Ephemeral port differences affect address-bar glyphs; verified and normal cases are not identical-input timing pairs.
Both runs exit zero with complete cleanup and no owned descendants. The gate binds controlled logical size plus latest browser physical loading size before releasing the document.

Original 1180x880 fallback/reload results belong to the preceding executable. Its older controller may see newly admitted startup frames before resize with this renderer; current validation uses the new gate.
The stripped debug binary is not a release/performance build. No latency, throughput, Chromium parity, complete standards compatibility or independent security assurance follows.
One selected NVIDIA/BGRA8 native surface was checked; earlier multi-adapter offscreen observations are separate.
